items.summary: moderngpu path (warp_size=32, inline PTX) not ported; k2/csrc/moderngpu_shim.h.

k2/torch (the standalone libtorch C++ decoder layer, ~28 files) is deferred on the ROCm build: k2/CMakeLists.txt skips the k2/torch subdir on HIP because it pulls in kaldifeat (csukuangfj/kaldifeat), a separate feature-extraction project. The core _k2 Python module + csrc gtest suite (what icefall/sherpa consume) are ported and validated. UN-DEFER once the kaldifeat MOAT project's lead is completed: then build/install AMD-Ecosystem/kaldifeat @ moat-port and re-enable the k2/torch subdir on HIP. Tracked as a depends_on(kaldifeat) relationship.

k2 moderngpu_shim segmented_sort: replace host-side SegmentsToHost sync + per-segment thrust::stable_sort_by_key loop with a single global stable_sort_by_key using a composite (row_id, key) comparator via ComputeRowIds (gemini bot #1353 review). Perf optimization; current impl is correct+validated. Do as a benchmarked follow-up, not in the enablement PR.
